features.spec_decoding.description.en: The W8A8/W4A8 checkpoints ship an MTP draft consumed with 3 speculative tokens (tutorial §5.1/§9.1). Keep the same method and token count on Prefill and Decode in PD deployment (tutorial §5.4). Method name: current images take `mtp` (the tutorial's `qwen3_5_mtp` emits a deprecation warning on nightly and maps to `mtp`; use the tutorial spelling on v0.30.0 release images).

features.tool_calling.description.en: Append to the `vllm serve` command (both Prefill and Decode in PD, then restart): --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser qwen3. Verify with a chat request carrying a tool definition; the serving process parses tool calls, it does not execute them (tutorial §6.1).
features.tool_calling.description.zh: 追加到 `vllm serve` 命令(PD 部署中 Prefill 与 Decode 都加,加完重启): --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser qwen3。用携带工具定义的 chat 请求验证;服务进程只解析工具调用,不执行工具(教程 §6.1)。

features.flashcomm1.description.en: MoE sequence parallelism; requires --enable-expert-parallel and TP > 1 (tutorial §9.3). The tutorial scripts enable it via the enable_flashcomm1 member of --additional-config (not via this env toggle); the env form follows the DeepSeek-V4-Flash recipe convention.
features.flashcomm1.description.zh: MoE 序列并行;要求 --enable-expert-parallel 且 TP > 1(教程 §9.3)。教程脚本经 --additional-config 的 enable_flashcomm1 成员启用(非本 env 开关);env 形式依 DeepSeek-V4-Flash recipe 惯例。

features.prefix_caching.description.en: Enabled in the tutorial A3 single-node and PD examples (§5.1/§5.4); the A2 MP example disables it (§5.2). Short prefixes may not be cached when the hybrid KV cache manager adjusts the block size to a large value (tutorial §5.1 note).
features.prefix_caching.description.zh: 教程 A3 单机与 PD 示例启用(§5.1/§5.4);A2 MP 示例关闭(§5.2)。混合 KV 缓存管理器将 block size 调大时,短前缀可能不被缓存(教程 §5.1 注)。

features.async_scheduling.description.en: Present in the 950DT single-node example of the 2026-10 revision (since removed from the online tutorial); optional on A3 (the flag appears in the §5.4 PD scripts). Not enabled in the A3 single-node scenario below.

overview.en:
The tutorial publishes three deployment topologies: single-node W8A8 on one Atlas 800I A3
(64 GB x 16) with TP16 and a 133K context (§5.1); two-node MP on Atlas 800I A2 (64 GB x 8
each) (§5.2); and 1P1D PD disaggregation on a single 16-NPU A3 host with the W4A8 checkpoint
(§5.4, Prefill TP8 on devices 0-7, Decode TP4/DP2 on devices 8-15, MooncakeConnectorV1 with
the standard Pull proxy). The 2026-10 revision of the tutorial also documented
single-node W4A4-MXFP4 on one 950DT product (96 GB x 8), W4A8C8 PD across 950DT products,
and PD on A2; those sections are not present in the current online tutorial, and the
scenarios below preserve them verbatim as display-only references. Reference accuracy for
W8A8 on vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0: AISBench GPQA 88 (§7.1). The quantized checkpoints used in the
tutorial deployment examples ship an MTP draft served through the qwen3_5_mtp speculative
method with 3 tokens (§9.1).

Pull proxy)。教程 2026-10 修订版另载三节:单台 950DT 产品(96 GB x 8)W4A4-MXFP4、950DT

W8A8 serves on one Atlas 800I A3 (64 GB x 16) node with TP16 and a 133K context

```bash
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"

# Host-level tuning; skipped gracefully inside the verify container (read-only /sys, no sysctl perms)

  # single-node value 1 is kept (root cause pending).
vllm serve your_model_path \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 16 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --seed 1024 \
  --quantization ascend \
  --served-model-name qwen3.5 \
  --max-num-seqs 128 \
  --max-model-len 133000 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --speculative-config '{"method": "qwen3_5_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "enforce_eager": true}' \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
```

scenarios[1].steps[0].content.en:
PD disaggregation on one 16-NPU Atlas 800I A3 host with the W4A8 checkpoint
(tutorial §5.4). The 16 NPUs are split into two non-overlapping device sets:
Prefill = devices 0-7 (TP8/DP1, port 30060, Mooncake kv_port 55220, eager mode),
Decode = devices 8-15 (TP4/DP2, port 30050, Mooncake kv_port 56010,
FULL_DECODE_ONLY + recompute scheduler). A standard Pull proxy binds
Prefill 30060 + Decode 30050 behind port 8000 (tutorial §5.4.3). Note: the tutorial
documents this as a single-host 1P1D topology ("two service groups", not two
hosts); the first-party verification follows this topology on one 16-NPU host.
A cross-host 2-node variant was verified on 2026-10-30 — see the cross-host note below.
scenarios[1].steps[0].content.zh:
单台 16-NPU Atlas 800I A3 主机上的 PD 分离,使用 W4A8 checkpoint(教程 §5.4)。
16 卡切分为两个不重叠设备组:Prefill=0-7 号卡(TP8/DP1,端口 30060,Mooncake
kv_port 55220,eager 模式);Decode=8-15 号卡(TP4/DP2,端口 30050,Mooncake
kv_port 56010,FULL_DECODE_ONLY+重算调度器)。标准 Pull proxy 将 Prefill 30060 与
Decode 30050 绑定到 8000 端口(教程 §5.4.3)。注:教程将其文档化为单主机 1P1D 拓扑
("两个服务组",非两台主机);第一方验证即按此拓扑在单台 16-NPU 主机完成。跨机
2 节点形态已于 2026-10-30 验证——见下方跨机小节。

endpoint. Example generation kwargs (tutorial §7.1):


faq.en:
For common environment, installation, and general parameter issues, refer to the
[Public FAQs](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html) (tutorial §10).

- **Q: Why does the service report OOM during startup or soon after accepting requests?**

  A: Check that the weight precision and device allocation match the weight table, and use
  `--quantization ascend` for the quantized examples. Reduce context length, concurrency, or
  batched tokens, and leave runtime memory headroom in `--gpu-memory-utilization`
  (tutorial Q1).

- **Q: Why does multi-node MP deployment hang during initialization?**

  A: Verify connectivity per the communication check; bind `HCCL_IF_IP` to the selected
  NIC's IP and `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`/`GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME` to its interface name; check the DP
  master address, matching RPC ports, non-overlapping rank ranges, and the worker node's
  `--headless` option (tutorial Q2).

- **Q: Can I enable prefix caching in PD disaggregation?**

  A: The A3 PD, 950DT W4A8C8 PD and A2 PD examples enable prefix caching. When changing this
  setting, compare cached and uncached outputs, request completion, and cache reuse with the
  same connector and software version (tutorial Q3).
- **Q: Why does performance regress after enabling sequence parallelism or Fused MC2?**
  (tutorial FAQ Q4)

  A: Use the hardware-specific settings in the tuning table (§9.3). Under the same
  workload, compare FlashComm and MC2 separately against their disabled settings
  (`enable_flashcomm1=false` and `enable_fused_mc2=0`). Preserve other required
  `--additional-config` fields and check output correctness before comparing performance.
  The A2 examples do not enable MC2.

- **Q: How should I tune MTP speculative decoding for this model?**
  (tutorial FAQ Q5)

  A: Start with `num_speculative_tokens=3`, then compare TTFT, TPOT, and throughput when
  adjusting it. For PD deployment, keep `method` and `num_speculative_tokens` identical on
  Prefill and Decode; for an MTP-off comparison, remove `--speculative-config` from both
  sides. Change one setting at a time and check generated answers alongside acceptance
  statistics; acceptance rate alone does not establish accuracy.

- **Q: Why do C8 PD outputs contain repeated exclamation marks or lose accuracy?**
  (tutorial FAQ Q6)

  A: Check that both nodes use the same C8 checkpoint revision and `--kv-cache-dtype
  mxfp8`, with the topology and connector settings in §5.5 and the requirements in
  §5.5.4 of the 2026-10 revision (since removed from the online tutorial). Inspect
  checkpoint-loading and KV-transfer logs. After correcting the environment or
  configuration, restart both services and verify short requests before
  running the full accuracy evaluation. Earlier prerelease K/V-scale issues were fixed by
  [#19017](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/19017), included in v0.30.0.

- **Q: Why is the benchmark score low despite apparently normal model answers?**
  (tutorial FAQ Q7)

  A: Inspect predictions for empty responses, truncated outputs, and answer-extraction
  failures. Correlate failed requests with P/D and proxy logs, including transfer
  timeouts and streaming errors. Report the full-dataset score and failure counts, and
  verify the dataset, chat template, sampling parameters, and output budget against §7.1.

- **Q: Why do HIXL/Mooncake connections time out after the HTTP service starts?**
  (tutorial FAQ Q8)

  A: HTTP readiness does not verify KV transfer. Check P/D service IPs, NICs, routes,
  physical NPU IDs, communication resource mounts, and KV ports using §3.2 and the
  Mooncake deployment guide. Ensure both nodes use matching runtime environments. After
  correcting the configuration, restart both services and send a request through the
  proxy as described in §6.
faq.zh:
常见环境、安装与通用参数问题参见[公共 FAQs](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html)(教程 §10)。

- **问:服务启动时或接收请求后不久报 OOM?**

  答:核对权重精度与设备分配是否匹配权重表,量化示例使用 `--quantization ascend`。降低
  上下文长度、并发或 batched tokens,并在 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 中留出运行时内存余量
  (教程 Q1)。

- **问:多机 MP 部署初始化挂起?**

  答:按通信验证核对连通性;将 `HCCL_IF_IP` 绑定为所选网卡的 IP、`HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`/
  `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME` 绑定其接口名;核对 DP 主地址、一致的 RPC 端口、不重叠的 rank 区间与
  worker 节点的 `--headless` 选项(教程 Q2)。

- **问:PD 分离中能否启用前缀缓存?**

  答:A3 PD、950DT W4A8C8 PD 与 A2 PD 示例均启用前缀缓存。更改该设置时,须在相同 connector
  与软件版本下对比缓存与非缓存输出、请求完成与缓存复用(教程 Q3)。
- **问:启用序列并行或 Fused MC2 后性能回退?**
  (教程 FAQ Q4)

  答:按调优表(§9.3)的硬件专属设置操作。相同负载下,将 FlashComm 与 MC2 分别与其关闭
  状态(`enable_flashcomm1=false`、`enable_fused_mc2=0`)对比;保留其他必需的
  `--additional-config` 字段,并在对比性能前先确认输出正确性。A2 示例不启用 MC2。

- **问:本模型的 MTP 投机解码如何调优?**
  (教程 FAQ Q5)

  答:从 `num_speculative_tokens=3` 起步,调整时对比 TTFT、TPOT 与吞吐。PD 部署中
  Prefill 与 Decode 的 `method` 与 `num_speculative_tokens` 必须一致;做 MTP 关闭对比时,
  两侧都移除 `--speculative-config`。每次只改一项,并结合生成答案与接受率统计检查;
  仅凭接受率不能证明精度。

- **问:C8 PD 输出出现重复感叹号或精度损失?**
  (教程 FAQ Q6)

  答:检查两节点使用相同 C8 checkpoint revision 与 `--kv-cache-dtype mxfp8`,拓扑与
  connector 设置符合 §5.5、约束符合 §5.5.4(2026-10 修订版,在线已移除);检查
  checkpoint 加载与 KV 传输日志。修正环境或配置后重启两服务,先用短请求验证再
  跑完整精度评测。早期预发布版 K/V scale
  问题已由 [#19017](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/19017) 修复,
  含于 v0.30.0。

- **问:模型回答看起来正常,但评测分数偏低?**
  (教程 FAQ Q7)

  答:检查预测中的空响应、截断输出与答案抽取失败;将失败请求与 P/D 及代理日志关联
  (含传输超时与流式错误);上报全量数据集分数与失败计数,并按 §7.1 核对数据集、chat
  template、采样参数与输出预算。

- **问:HTTP 服务起来后 HIXL/Mooncake 连接超时?**
  (教程 FAQ Q8)

  答:HTTP 就绪不代表 KV 传输正常。按 §3.2 与 Mooncake 部署指南检查 P/D 服务 IP、网卡、
  路由、物理 NPU 编号、通信资源挂载与 KV 端口;确保两节点运行环境一致。修正配置后重启
  两服务,并按 §6 经代理发送请求验证。
